description: This file defines a Flutter widget called DotIndicator, which displays a dot that can be active or inactive, typically used in indicator components such as carousel or page indicators.

classes.name: DotIndicator
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a customizable animated dot, used as an indicator (e.g., in carousels).
